metadata.description: Paul Cheek's personal Claude Code plugins: chief-of-staff agents for his own calendar and life admin.

plugins.name: calendar-manager
plugins.description: Eight agents run Paul's calendar SOP from cloud routines: conflicts, commute and travel blocks, Legend colors, notes, 1:1s, invites missing from his calendar, holds on times he offers by email, and working location and out-of-office that follow him around the world, all time-zone strict. Writes come from riley@cheek.org; they learn from Paul's answers in a private memory repo. A hook blocks deletes, invites (Callie on travel excepted), RSVPs, messages, force-pushes and any edit to the past.
